title: Brody & Bills Blues Jam @ Uptown Lounge
event_description: Weekly blues jam session hosted by Brody Buster and Coyote Bill. Open to all musicians - jam with the house band or showcase your skills. Epic musical experience in an upscale cocktail lounge setting. Great vibes whether you jam or just listen.
event_venue_information:
Uptown Lounge - Kansas City's Upscale Jazz & Blues Venue

Uptown Lounge located at 3400 Main Street in midtown Kansas City is a premier upscale cocktail and piano bar that hosts live music five nights a week. The venue combines an elegant atmosphere craft cocktails and world-class live music creating a sophisticated venue for music lovers.

Tuesday Blues Jam

Every Tuesday night from 8pm-midnight Brody Buster and Coyote Bill host the Brody & Bills Blues Jam. This is an open jam where musicians of all skill levels are welcome to participate. The house band provides professional backing and the atmosphere is welcoming whether you're a seasoned performer or trying jam for the first time. Audiences consistently describe the Tuesday jam as an epic musical experience.

Upscale Atmosphere

Unlike dive bar open mics Uptown Lounge offers an upscale sophisticated setting. The venue features beautiful interior design with thoughtful lighting and elegant décor. The full bar offers craft cocktails and quality beverages. The environment is refined and classy making it an ideal destination for a night out that combines great music with upscale ambiance.

Jazz & Live Music Focus

The venue programs live music five nights a week across multiple genres. Tuesday features blues jam. Other nights showcase piano bar performances jazz acts and various musicians. The programming emphasizes quality live music as the core offering rather than DJs or recorded music.

Kansas City Jazz Heritage

Kansas City has a legendary jazz and blues heritage dating back decades. The city remains a vital live music destination. Uptown Lounge continues this tradition by hosting high-quality live performances and providing a gathering place for music lovers in midtown KC.

Midtown Location

Located in midtown Kansas City at 3400 Main Street the venue is part of the resurgence of Main Street as an entertainment and cultural district. The neighborhood features galleries restaurants and other venues creating a vibrant urban cultural scene.
